title: Sr. Oracle EPM developer
description:
Job Details

We are seeking an experienced Oracle ARCS Consultant with strong expertise in Oracle EPM Cloud solutions to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the implementation, configuration, and support of Oracle Account Reconciliation Cloud Service (ARCS) as well as contributing to broader Oracle EPM initiatives (such as FCCS, EPBCS, or EDMCS). This role requires both functional and technical knowledge to bridge finance and technology, ensuring streamlined reconciliation processes and effective enterprise performance management.

Primary duties include

1. Lead or support the end-to-end implementation of Oracle ARCS, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, deployment, and support.

2. Analyze reconciliation processes and automate high-volume matching scenarios.

3. Customize ARCS to meet business reconciliation and compliance needs, including transaction matching, automation rules, formats, profiles, and templates.

4. Integrate ARCS with source systems (e.g., ERP, GL, subledgers) and EPM modules using Data Management or Data Integration tools.

5. Collaborate with stakeholders (Finance, Accounting, IT) to design and implement process improvements and best practices using ARCS and other Oracle EPM applications.

6. Provide expertise and support for related Oracle EPM modules (e.g., FCCS, EPBCS, Narrative Reporting, etc.).

7. Develop and maintain technical and functional documentation, including training materials.

8. Conduct user training sessions and support UAT and production rollouts.

9. Stay current with Oracle Cloud updates, patches, and new features to assess impacts and improvements

Key success factors for a potential candidate (in addition to required skills)

· Self-starter

· Proactive; 'can do' problem solving attitude; Navigate through ambiguity

· Superior communication skills – Written & Verbal

· Ability to influence and align cross-functional teams

Qualifications:

Required:

· 5+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle ARCS, including Transaction Matching, implementation and support.

· Proven experience with Oracle EPM Cloud solutions, including at least one of the following: FCCS, EPBCS, EDMCS, or Narrative Reporting.

· Strong understanding of financial close, account reconciliation, and reporting processes.

· Experience with ARCS automation (e.g., transaction matching, rules, profiles).

· Familiarity with data integration tools (Data Management, FDMEE, or third-party ETL tools).

· Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

· Ability to work independently or as part of a global team.

Preferred:

· Oracle Cloud certification in ARCS and/or EPM Cloud modules.

· Experience with scripting (e.g., Groovy, SQL) for EPM automation.

· Knowledge of ERP systems (e.g., Oracle ERP Cloud, Peoplesoft, SAP).

title: SAP Techno-Functional Consultant - Finance
description:
Job Title

SAP Techno-Functional Consultant - Finance

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP Techno-Functional Consultant specializing in Finance to join our dynamic IT team. This role involves bridging technical and functional aspects of SAP FI/CO modules to optimize financial processes, ensure system efficiency, and support business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

· Analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP FI/CO configurations, customizations, and enhancements.

· Design, develop, and implement technical solutions within SAP Finance modules, including integration with other SAP components like MM, SD, and HCM.

· Conduct system testing, debugging, and troubleshooting to resolve issues in financial reporting, accounts payable/receivable, general ledger, and controlling functions.

· Collaborate with finance teams to provide functional expertise, conduct user training, and support data migration projects.

· Optimize SAP processes for compliance with financial regulations, such as GAAP or IFRS, and implement automation for improved efficiency.

· Participate in SAP upgrades, patches, and new module implementations while documenting technical specifications and user guides.

Required Qualifications

· 5+ years of experience as an SAP Techno-Functional Consultant with a focus on FI/CO modules.

· Strong knowledge of ABAP programming, SAP Fiori, and integration tools like PI/PO or CPI.

· Proven expertise in financial processes, including asset accounting, cost center accounting, and profitability analysis.

· Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams.

· SAP certification in FI/CO or related modules is highly preferred.

Preferred Skills

· Experience with S/4HANA migrations and cloud-based SAP solutions.

· Familiarity with data analytics tools and financial reporting in SAP BW or SAC.

· Strong communication skills for stakeholder engagement and requirement gathering

title: SAP Techno-Functional Consultant - Materials Management
description:
Job Title

SAP Techno-Functional Consultant - Materials Management

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled SAP Techno-Functional Consultant specializing in Materials Management to enhance our supply chain and procurement operations. This role focuses on configuring and customizing SAP MM modules to streamline inventory management, procurement processes, and vendor interactions while ensuring seamless integration with other SAP systems.

Key Responsibilities

· Gather and analyze business requirements to design and implement SAP MM solutions, including procurement, inventory management, and material valuation.

· Develop technical enhancements using ABAP, configure workflows, and integrate MM with modules like FI, SD, and PP for end-to-end process optimization.

· Perform system testing, troubleshooting, and performance tuning to resolve issues in purchasing, stock transfers, and logistics invoice verification.

· Collaborate with supply chain teams to provide functional training, support data migrations, and ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations.

· Participate in SAP upgrades, implement automation for procurement cycles, and create documentation for configurations and custom reports.

· Monitor and optimize MM processes for efficiency, such as vendor evaluation, contract management, and inventory forecasting.

Required Qualifications

· Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

· Minimum of 5 years of experience as an SAP Techno-Functional Consultant with expertise in MM modules.

· Proficiency in ABAP development, SAP Fiori interfaces, and integration tools like SAP PI/PO or CPI.

· Strong understanding of materials management processes, including MRP, batch management, and warehouse management integrations.

· Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

· SAP certification in MM or related areas is highly desirable.

Preferred Skills

· Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementations and cloud-based procurement solutions.

· Knowledge of advanced analytics in SAP for supply chain visibility and reporting tools like SAP BW or SAC.

· Familiarity with industry-specific regulations, such as those in manufacturing or logistics.

title: Oracle Techno-Functional Consultant - Finance
description:
Job Title

Oracle Techno-Functional Consultant - Finance

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Techno-Functional Consultant specializing in Finance to join our IT team and drive financial system optimizations. This role involves configuring and customizing Oracle Financials modules to support efficient accounting, reporting, and compliance processes while integrating with other enterprise systems.

Key Responsibilities

· Analyze business needs and implement solutions in Oracle Financials Cloud or EBS, focusing on modules like General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, and Fixed Assets.

· Develop technical customizations using PL/SQL, Oracle Forms/Reports, and integration tools such as Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) or SOA Suite.

· Conduct testing, debugging, and troubleshooting for financial workflows, ensuring data accuracy and system performance.

· Collaborate with finance stakeholders to provide functional expertise, user training, and support for data migrations and upgrades.

· Optimize processes for regulatory compliance, such as SOX or IFRS, and automate reporting through tools like Oracle BI Publisher.

· Document technical specifications, participate in system enhancements, and integrate Oracle Finance with modules like Procurement or HCM.

Required Qualifications

· At least 5 years of experience as an Oracle Techno-Functional Consultant with a focus on Financials modules.

· Proficiency in PL/SQL programming, Oracle APEX, and integration frameworks like OIC or REST APIs.

· Strong knowledge of financial processes, including cash management, budgeting, and financial consolidation.

· Excellent problem-solving abilities and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.

· Oracle certification in Financials or related modules is highly preferred.

Preferred Skills

· Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications and migrations from EBS to Cloud.

· Familiarity with analytics tools like Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) for financial reporting.

· Understanding of industry-specific financial regulations and best practices.

title: Automation Engineer - Azure
description:
Role: Automation Engineer - Azure
Location: Redmond Onsite day 1

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot automation scripts predominantly using PowerShell, and potentially C# programming, to streamline system configuration, deployment, and monitoring tasks on Windows platforms, integrating with Azure cloud services.
  • Work extensively with Azure cloud infrastructure, leveraging ARM templates or equivalent Infrastructure-as-Code technologies to automate cloud resource provisioning and management.
  • Conduct manual and automated testing of developed solutions both in Windows and Azure ecosystems to validate performance and reliability standards.
  • Collaborate with solution architects, software engineers, and operations teams to identify automation opportunities, contribute to system design, and improve deployment workflows.
  • Undertake proactive problem solving and incident resolution, minimizing downtime and ensuring operational excellence in cloud-based and on-premises environments.
  • Operate with a high degree of independence, demonstrating initiative to manage and prioritize workload while maintaining clear communication with stakeholders.
  • Preferred Experience and Skills:
  • 3-5 years of professional experience in Windows Platform Engineering with demonstrated expertise in automation engineering.
  • Proficiency with Azure cloud services, including hands-on experience creating, managing, and testing automated deployments using ARM templates or similar tools.
  • Strong scripting skills, preferably in PowerShell, with additional programming capabilities in C# viewed favorably.
  • Familiarity with Linux systems is advantageous but not essential, complementing Windows-based automation skill sets.
  • Excellent communication skills, enabling effective collaboration within diverse teams and the ability to document technical processes clearly.
  • Client-centric mindset, passion for delivering results, and learning agility to quickly adopt and apply new technologies.
Mandatory Skills: Windows Platform Engineering .

Experience: 3-5 Years .
